points.point: The documented automotive use of the CMX500 signaling tester is functional tests, protocol conformity tests and type-approval of In-Vehicle Systems implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall
points.label: partial
points.why: Identifies eCall/NG eCall/hybrid eCall as the automotive focus, but omits functional tests, protocol conformity tests, type-approval and IVS framing.

points.point: Core validation items for a vehicle eCall implementation are call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning and intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE and circuit-switched fallback
points.label: covered
points.why: States call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning and intelligible voice quality, and separately names VoNR, VoLTE and circuit-switched fallback.

points.point: Signaling tests must also prove robustness during handovers and under degraded radio conditions, which the test environment provides by simulating real-world mobile network conditions and emulating various network scenarios
points.label: covered
points.why: Explicitly mentions handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network simulation and emulation of network scenarios.

points.point: PSAP emulation with voice and data transmission on both 4G and 5G is the capability used to validate NG eCall compliance with EN 17240:2024 (CMX500 mobile radio tester, CMX-KA098 option)
points.label: partial
points.why: Covers PSAP simulation, voice/data validation, NG eCall over 4G/5G and EN 17240:2024 context, but does not name CMX-KA098.

points.point: The NGeCall capability lists name the required signaling procedures: eCall-only mode, timers T3444/T3445 and SRVCC handover to the CS domain / UTRAN / GERAN, alongside IMS eCall session establishment, MSD transfer/update and PSAP callback
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions IMS and MSD only generally, but omits eCall-only mode, T3444/T3445, SRVCC to CS/UTRAN/GERAN, MSD update and PSAP callback.

points.point: Audio-path capability is part of the configuration: CMX audio enabler (codecs), external media endpoint audio (CMX-ZG180) and CMX-KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP tests
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions audio/codecs, but omits external media endpoint CMX-ZG180 and CMX-KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP.

points.point: GNSS receiver/performance testing for eCall modules is a separate capability provided by the R&S SMBV100B with the SMBV-K361 eCall test suite
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions GNSS positioning, but not the separate R&S SMBV100B with SMBV-K361 eCall GNSS receiver/performance test capability.

points.point: Vault records that not all eCall signaling test cases can be automated by the test software alone — HMI interaction, ignition OFF control, AT commands, prepared test USIM, crash simulation or in-band modem over IP support may be needed
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not mention automation limitations or required HMI, ignition, AT commands, USIM, crash simulation or in-band modem support.

invented: General signaling capabilities include LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement
OTA signaling can also be relevant where automotive wireless devices require antenna or radiated testing
